estimate_limits: PoT backing, no mipmaps; palette stored separately, excluded allocator rounding; CPU grades/strip/raw and render targets still require runtime implementation changes; estimates summed across the library are not concurrent GPU residency or measured savings.
pixel_exact_rule: At most 256 distinct RGBA tuples; P4 at most 16. Alpha is counted. Zero-alpha RGB normalization is reported separately and is not pixel identical.
runtime_gray_exception: 60 exact candidates are grayscale PNG; existing grade.raw gray-r8 requests may already use R8. Metadata payload estimates alone do not prove RGBA residency.
